records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin accepto 'receive', frequentative of accipiō, formed from ad- + capiō 'to take'.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: Latin anticipātus, of anticipō 'to anticipate' (see -ate), from ante-, + capiō 'to take' + -ō.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from capāx 'able to hold much', from capiō 'to hold, to contain, to take, to understand'.

note: accept / anticipate / capacity 均落在 capiō 'to take'；注意 except 词条只到 exceptus，未展开 capere。 词库外旁证条目（仅印证同一词源，不对应词库词条）：anticipate。
